nominations.basis: Probed 2026-09-18 with scripts/probe_candidate_pages.py: 3,664 readable characters and the verifier's own label test matched the department itself in the content region as "ED Offices | U.S. Department of Education". The same fetch also labels four of this node's children in content - "Federal Student Aid (FSA)", "Office for Civil Rights (OCR)", "Office of Elementary and Secondary Education (OESE)" and "Institute of Education Sciences (IES)" - so it is the page that can evidence the exec-dept-ed -> child EDGES. It has to sit in THIS node's entry to do that: verify_base_graph.py's placement pass reads sites[parent_id] (scripts/verify_base_graph.py line 181, 'parent_id not in sites'), so the same URL recorded under a child's id evidences no edge and, being distance 0 in evidence.candidate_urls, would publish method name_labelled_on_own_official_page - the department's office list described as the child's own page. Recorded here, and the department's existing candidate https://www.ed.gov/about is untouched; note it answered 403 on the 2026-09-16 verifier run, so this is a second readable page for a node whose only one is intermittent.
